title: 里仁
label: 里仁 in modern Chinese
credit: Modern rendering of Analects Book 4 written by Claude; not a published translation.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“住在有仁德的地方才好。选住的地方，不选有仁德的，怎么能算聪明呢？”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Living where there is humaneness is what is good. If you choose a place to live and do not choose one that has humaneness, how can that count as clever?"
chapters.note: Classical 4.1: 里仁為美。擇不處仁，焉得知？ 住 is 處 and 里; 选 is 擇; 怎么能 is 焉得; 聪明 is 知.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“没有仁德的人，不能长久地过穷日子，也不能长久地过快乐的日子。有仁德的人有了仁德才安心，聪明的人知道仁德有好处才去做。”
wfw: at ease, with a mind at rest
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "A person without humaneness cannot live long in poverty, and cannot live long in happiness either. A person with humaneness is at ease only once he has humaneness; a clever person does it only because he knows humaneness brings benefit."
chapters.note: Classical 4.2: 仁者安仁，知者利仁。 没有仁德的人 is 不仁者: the classical 者 has become 的人.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“只有有仁德的人，才能喜欢人，才能讨厌人。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Only a person with humaneness can like people, and can dislike people."
chapters.note: Classical 4.3: 唯仁者能好人，能惡人。 只有…才 is 唯; 喜欢 is 好 (hào); 讨厌 is 惡 (wù).

chapters.text: 孔子说：“如果真的立志做有仁德的人，就不会做坏事了。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "If you really set your aim on being a person of humaneness, you will not do bad things."
chapters.note: Classical 4.4: 苟志於仁矣，無惡也。 如果真的 is 苟.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“有钱和有地位，是人人都想要的；不用正当的方法得到，君子不接受。没钱和没地位，是人人都讨厌的；不用正当的方法离开，君子不离开。君子离开了仁德，怎么能成名呢？君子连吃一顿饭的时间也不离开仁德，匆忙的时候一定这样，困难的时候也一定这样。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Being rich and having status are what everyone wants; if they are not got by the proper way, the gentleman does not accept them. Being poor and having no status are what everyone dislikes; if they cannot be left by the proper way, the gentleman does not leave them. If the gentleman leaves humaneness, how can he make his name? The gentleman does not leave humaneness even for the time it takes to eat a meal: in a rush he is surely like this, and in difficulty he is surely like this too."
chapters.note: Classical 4.5. 有钱 is 富, 有地位 is 貴, 没钱 is 貧, 没地位 is 賤. 离开 is the classical 去: 君子去仁 has become 君子离开了仁德.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“我没有见过喜欢仁德的人，也没有见过讨厌不仁德的事的人。喜欢仁德的人，觉得没有比仁德更好的东西了；讨厌不仁德的事的人，他做的也是仁德的事，因为他不让不仁德的事到自己身上。有人能在一天里把力气都用在仁德上吗？我没有见过力气不够的人。也许有这样的人，可是我没有见过。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "I have never seen a person who likes humaneness, nor one who hates what is inhumane. A person who likes humaneness feels there is nothing better than humaneness. A person who hates what is inhumane: what he does is humane too, because he does not let inhumane things reach his own person. Is there anyone who can put all his strength into humaneness for one day? I have never seen a person whose strength was not enough. Perhaps there are such people, but I have not seen one."
chapters.note: Classical 4.6. 我没有见过 is 我未見; 力气不够 is 力不足; 也许 is 蓋.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“人的错误，各有各的种类。看一个人犯的错误，就知道他是什么样的人了。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "People's mistakes each have their own kind. Look at the mistakes a person makes and you know what kind of person he is."
chapters.note: Classical 4.7: 觀過，斯知人矣。 看 is 觀; 错误 is 過; 就 is 斯.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“早上听到了真理，晚上死了也可以。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Hear the truth in the morning, and it is all right even to die that evening."
chapters.note: Classical 4.8: 朝聞道，夕死可矣。 Word for word: 朝 早上, 聞 听到, 道 真理, 夕 晚上, 死 死, 可 可以.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“读书人立志追求真理，可是觉得穿得不好、吃得不好很丢人，这样的人不值得和他讨论。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "A scholar who sets his aim on pursuing the truth, yet feels that dressing badly and eating badly are shameful: such a person is not worth discussing things with."
chapters.note: Classical 4.9: 恥惡衣惡食者，未足與議也。 丢人 is 恥; 不值得 is 未足; 和他讨论 is 與議.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“君子对于天下的事，没有一定要这样做的，也没有一定不这样做的，怎样合理就怎样做。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "In the affairs of the world, the gentleman has nothing he must do in one fixed way and nothing he must not do that way: whatever is right, that is how he does it."
chapters.note: Classical 4.10: 無適也，無莫也，義之與比。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“君子想的是道德，小人想的是土地；君子想的是法律，小人想的是好处。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "What the gentleman thinks of is virtue; what the small man thinks of is land. What the gentleman thinks of is the law; what the small man thinks of is benefit."
chapters.note: Classical 4.11: 君子懷德，小人懷土；君子懷刑，小人懷惠。 想的 is "what he thinks of": 的 with no noun after it.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“只为了自己的好处做事，会有很多人怨恨你。”
wfw: for the sake of, in order to
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "If you do things only for your own benefit, many people will resent you."
chapters.note: Classical 4.12: 放於利而行，多怨。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“能用礼让来管理国家，管理国家还有什么困难呢？不能用礼让来管理国家，礼又有什么用呢？”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "If one can run the state with ritual and deference, what difficulty is left in running a state? If one cannot run the state with ritual and deference, then what use is ritual?"
chapters.note: Classical 4.13: 能以禮讓為國…如禮何？ 用 is 以; 管理国家 is 為國.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“不要担心没有职位，要担心自己有没有站得住的本事。不要担心没有人了解自己，要努力成为值得别人了解的人。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Do not worry about having no post; worry about whether you have the ability to stand firm. Do not worry that no one knows you; work to become a person worth knowing."
chapters.note: Classical 4.14: 不患無位，患所以立。 担心 is 患; 职位 is 位; 站得住 is 立.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“曾参啊！我的道理是用一个基本的想法连起来的。”曾子说：“是的。”孔子出去以后，别的学生问：“这是什么意思？”曾子说：“老师的道理，只是忠和恕罢了。”
wfw: putting oneself in the other's place
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Zeng Shen! My teaching is strung together with one basic idea." Zengzi said: "Yes." After Confucius went out, the other students asked: "What does this mean?" Zengzi said: "The Master's teaching is just 忠 and 恕, nothing more."
chapters.note: Classical 4.15: 吾道一以貫之…忠恕而已矣。 忠 is doing one's utmost for others; 恕 is putting oneself in the other's place. 罢了 is 而已矣.

chapters.text: 孔子说：“君子明白的是什么是对的，小人明白的是什么有好处。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "What the gentleman understands is what is right; what the small man understands is what brings benefit."
chapters.note: Classical 4.16: 君子喻於義，小人喻於利。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“看见好人，就想要和他一样好；看见不好的人，就在心里检查自己。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "When you see a good person, want to be as good as he is; when you see a person who is not good, examine yourself inwardly."
chapters.note: Classical 4.17: 見賢思齊焉，見不賢而內自省也。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“父母有不对的地方，要好好地劝他们；看到他们不听，还是要尊敬他们，不反对他们，再辛苦也不怨恨。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "When your parents are in the wrong on some point, advise them gently. If you see they will not listen, still respect them and do not oppose them; however hard it is, do not resent it."
chapters.note: Classical 4.18: 事父母幾諫，見志不從，又敬不違，勞而不怨。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“父母还活着的时候，不要去很远的地方；如果要去，一定要有确定的地方。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "While your parents are still alive, do not go to faraway places; if you have to go, you must have a definite place."
chapters.note: Classical 4.19: 父母在，不遠遊，遊必有方。 Here 去 is the modern "go", not the classical "leave".

chapters.text: 孔子说：“三年不改变父亲的做法，就可以说是孝了。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "If for three years he does not change his father's way of doing things, he can be called filial."
chapters.note: Classical 4.20: 三年無改於父之道，可謂孝矣。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“父母的年纪，不可以不知道：一方面为他们活得长而高兴，一方面为他们老了而害怕。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "Your parents' age must not go unknown: on the one hand you are glad that they have lived long, on the other you are afraid because they have grown old."
chapters.note: Classical 4.21: 一則以喜，一則以懼。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“古时候的人不轻易说话，因为他们觉得说了做不到是很丢人的。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "People of ancient times did not speak lightly, because they felt it shameful to say a thing and not manage to do it."
chapters.note: Classical 4.22: 古者言之不出，恥躬之不逮也。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“因为约束自己而犯错误的人，是很少的。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "People who make mistakes because they restrain themselves are very few."
chapters.note: Classical 4.23: 以約失之者鮮矣。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“君子想要说话慢一点，做事快一点。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "The gentleman wants to be a little slow in speaking and a little quick in doing."
chapters.note: Classical 4.24: 君子欲訥於言而敏於行。

chapters.text: 孔子说：“有道德的人不会孤单，一定有人和他在一起。”
chapters.translation: Confucius said: "A person of virtue will not be lonely; there will surely be people with him."
chapters.note: Classical 4.25: 德不孤，必有鄰。

chapters.text: 子游说：“对待君主，劝得太多，就会受到侮辱；对待朋友，劝得太多，就会被疏远。”
chapters.translation: Ziyou said: "In dealing with a ruler, if you urge him too much you will be humiliated; in dealing with friends, if you urge them too much you will be kept at a distance."
chapters.note: Classical 4.26: 事君數，斯辱矣；朋友數，斯疏矣。
